en.headline: Over 75% of Wang Chi House owners sign sale agreements
en.dek: The Housing Bureau said 188 households, or about 75.8 per cent of the undamaged block at Wang Fuk Court, had signed Agreements for Sale and Purchase as of Wednesday.
body: The Government confirmed on Thursday that it would continue the acquisition of Wang Chi House at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po after more than three-quarters of owners signed sale agreements.

As of 2 September, 188 households representing about 75.8 per cent of the block had signed the Agreements for Sale and Purchase. Across the whole estate, 1,595 households, or about 80.4 per cent, had completed the same step.
The Housing Bureau said it would continue to arrange completion of the remaining transfers. Owners who sell can take cash or join a special sales exercise for subsidised flats.

zh.headline: 宏志閣逾七成五業主簽買賣協議 政府繼續收購
zh.dek: 房屋局表示，截至周三共188戶、約75.8%宏志閣業主已簽署《買賣協議》，政府確認繼續推進該座業權收購。
body: 政府周四確認，大埔宏福苑H座宏志閣已有逾四分之三業主簽署買賣協議，當局會繼續推進該座業權收購工作。
截至9月2日，宏志閣共188戶、約75.8%業主已簽署《買賣協議》。宏福苑A至H座整體則有1,595戶、約80.4%業主完成同一步驟。
房屋局表示會陸續與餘下業主完成轉讓手續。出售業權的業主可選擇現金，或參與特設銷售計劃以樓換樓方式購入資助出售單位。
